descriptionHtml:
Make a stylish statement at your next evening event with our Plus Size Dazzling Empire Waist See-Through Long Sleeves A-Line Evening Dress. Crafted with a flattering empire waist and see-through long sleeves, this dress exudes elegance and sophistication. Whether you're attending a glamorous gala or a formal wedding, this dress will ensure you stand out in any scene.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor length.


Sleeve Style: Long sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sequin.


Stretch: Fabric is low stretch.
